title: 英文第五、4題｜By whom 的被動疑問句
question: be / the garbage / By whom / taken out / is / going to / ? （重組句子）
answer: By whom is the garbage going to be taken out?
explanation: 依題目給的字組，先將問執行者的 By whom 放在句首。這是直接疑問句，再把 is 移到主詞 the garbage 前，接 going to be taken out。原作答把 by whom 留在最後，接近覆問時確認聽到的資訊；依重組題要求，採一般直接詢問的句型。
studentAnswer: The garbage is going to be taken out by whom? → By whom is the garbage going to be taken out?（紅筆訂正）
subject: English
trap: 重組時從題目已給的 By whom 起句，再排 is＋主詞＋going to be＋過去分詞。
